conclusion: The available evidence contains multiple direct contradictions on key project aspects, preventing any definitive determination of the beta release schedule, team size, spending figures, security incident details, or December readiness/completion status. No fact can be confirmed with certainty, and further corroborating evidence is required to resolve these disputes.
evidence_gaps: No independent source confirms the exact beta release date or whether it was delayed.
No reliable record of the actual peak team size or membership changes.
No reconciled financial report to determine accurate spending by July or August 2024.
No authoritative incident log to verify the correct date and number of affected accounts.
No definitive assessment of platform readiness or unresolved performance issues as of December 2024.
